conventions.balanced_accuracy: Mean across maps of mean recall over classes present in each map.
conventions.paired_correct: Pooled changed-component pixels with both original and flipped answers correct.
conventions.sustained_95: First tested horizon with aggregate BA>=.95 at it and all later tested horizons; missing=null.
conventions.damage_eligibility: Per-map pre-damage BA>=.95 at T64; zero eligible gives null conditional outcome.
conventions.labels: Random position-independent component identities, conditioned on both labels appearing per original map.
conventions.geometry: Rooms grow with canvas size; walls and doors stay one pixel wide.
conventions.spatial_operator: Whole-grid replicated-boundary five-point positive Laplacian, not component-masked.
conventions.timing: Three warmups then median of three synchronized batch-eight full inference times divided by eight; throughput-normalized per-query timing, not isolated batch-one latency.
